entries.zh: 蒸馏器；蒸馏甑（熬煮酒液、收取其蒸气凝露的器具）
entries.en: still, alembic; a distilling vessel (lit. "boiling head")
entries.notes: H 栏原字“熬頭”非习见词，据“熬”“頭”字义与 L alquitara 定为甑之顶盖，代指整具蒸馏器。

entries.zh: 蒸馏桶；可熬蒸酒类及其他任何物件的甑桶（甑身）
entries.en: still-vat, boiler; a still for wines or any other thing
entries.notes: L 栏两处“℔ᵃ”符号未详，疑为 para（用于）一类缩略；H“熬桶”就字形指甑之桶身，与 L 之器身义相合。

entries.zh: 蒸酒器；专用于熬蒸酒液的甑
entries.en: wine-still; a still for distilling wine

entries.zh: 高；兼指形体之高与道德上之高尚
entries.en: high, tall; lofty, both in the natural and in the moral sense
entries.notes: L 栏起首“L. Lo”当为“Lo natural y moral m.te”（moralmente）之截录，义据 alto 与 H“高”仍可定。

entries.en: towering, lofty; very high and noble
lofty and exalted; very high and noble

entries.zh: 高高在上；高，然尚有更高者
entries.en: high above; high, but there is one yet higher
entries.notes: H 为成语“高高在上”，偏指居高临下，L 则强调比较（“另有更高者”），二义侧重略异。

entries.en: tall, high; long of stature
entries.notes: H“長”与 R 栏 chiàngⁿ 不合“長”之常读，疑原稿字讹或借字；L 明作 alto，参“長”之长大义定之。

entries.zh: 耸；耸立而高，兼含尊贵义
entries.en: to tower, towering; lofty, high and noble
entries.notes: M 栏 tiǒng 后附“+”号，当为承前条之省文标记。

entries.zh: 台；对高官的敬称（显贵官长）
entries.en: a high, noble mandarin; honorific for a high official
entries.notes: L 作 alto noble mandarin，“台”取对官长之敬称义，非“台榭”之本义。

entries.en: an exalted official; a high noble mandarin

entries.zh: 高；就连续量度与距离而言的高度（抽象之高）
entries.en: height; high as a continuous quantity and in distance
entries.notes: M 栏作 cuān，与“高”之常读不合，疑原稿借训“高”之方音字当之或栏位错置；L 明训 alto en cantidad continua y distancia，义据 L 定。

entries.en: tall and large; of great height and bulk
lofty, sublime; high and noble

entries.zh: 岑；高峻（如教堂台阶层层升高之状）
entries.en: high and steep, rising stepwise (like church stairs); a lofty bank
entries.notes: “岑”本义为高而陡的崖岸，L 以“教堂台阶”设喻，层递而高之义系由比喻推得。

entries.en: pavilion; a high building set at the top, high up
entries.notes: “閣”本指架高之楼阁，L 作 alto en cima，顶端之义系推得；M 栏并存 cǒỹ、cô 两读。

entries.en: the upper part of a house; the upper storey, upstairs

entries.zh: 楼阁；房屋上层之楼（多层建筑）
entries.en: a storied building, tower; the upper part of a house
upstairs; the upper part of the house, the part above
mountain summit, peak; the top of a mountain
the top of anything; summit
